_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution: the mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so its oracle registration and catalog live here rather than in the shared ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🧪️oracle/🔣️component.json manifest. `flate2` is already the plugin's registered zlib-compression oracle (capability zlib-compression), but that entry cannot cover mutation coverage without re-surveying it for this capability, so this is a distinct id.

oracles.rationale: The reference zlib/deflate implementation of the Rust ecosystem, used here as the independent encoder/decoder for every typed RFC1950 mutation kind. CMF/FLG/DICTID framing is fixed bit arithmetic RFC1950 mandates (not a competing 'implementation'), computed independently in this subset's own oracle module; flate2 supplies the actual DEFLATE entropy coding and the real Adler-32 trailer that arithmetic alone cannot fabricate. Deterministic given the same call sequence, no network, no system dependencies, cross-platform.
